name: io.github.shrec/aiworkhub
description: Local-first, repository-native AI engineering control plane for VS Code and MCP

environmentVariables.name: AIWORKHUB_REPO_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Absolute path of the git repository to manage

environmentVariables.name: AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Write gate. Only the exact value 1 enables write operations such as queue mutations; any other value, including unset, keeps the server read-only.

environmentVariables.name: AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_LAUNCH
environmentVariables.description: Launch gate. Only the exact value 1 enables worker launches, and launches also need AIWORKHUB_ALLOW_WRITES=1; any other value, including unset, disables them.
